chapter: Working with Duke and final reflections
title: Dating his friendship with Duke Ellington
summary: Whaley fumbles whether he met Duke at the Kentucky Club in 1922 or about 1925, and that he followed Duke to the Cotton Club in 1927.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Yeah. Now what about Duke -- how did you and he get to be so tight? Tell me.
Oh, Duke -- let me see, Duke was playing at the Kentucky Club, and he --
Yeah, in New York here. And he used to ...
Let me see, that was '22. That was in '22.

And well, it wasn't '22. Yeah, I met Duke right after I came -- no, it must have been later. It was about, say, '25. Because it was right before Small's opened up on 135th Street, and the Savoy Ballroom, it was right before then that I met Duke -- but it was at the Robinson Restaurant, see, and I used to go up, when Duke was rehearsing, I used to hang around, you know, I used to hang around his place, and then I went to -- when he went to the Cotton Club, that was in '27, I used to go up there all the time, see, and that's how I -- Jimmy Lunceford's band came in '33 -- no, they came in '28, first, and they didn't do so good. So they came back in '31 at the Lafayette Theatre, and they went from there to Philadelphia, and they made a second one, and the pay jumped 100%.
